entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: Expose functions for actually performant MemoryMappedFile byte copies #122815

Closed

  • fetchzlibng-build failed in browser-wasm windows Debug AllSubsets_CoreCLR / Build product #117528
    11.0.0
  • Support Math and MathF SinCos as a JIT intrinsic #46682
  • IcuLocaleData.NameIndexToNumericData is not linker friendly #47967
  • TickCount on macOS/Linux does not include suspend time #119437
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [browser][coreCLR] rollup improvements #122814
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Assume hash handles are always reusable in HashProviderCng. #122813
    area-System.Security
  • Remove use of BCryptDeriveKeyPBKDF2. #122812
    area-System.Security

Merged

  • Remove Environment.IsWindows8OrAbove property and related Windows 7 compatibility code #122810
    area-System.Runtime

Updated

  • Generate calls to interface methods through resolve helper #122639
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Cleanup __builtin_available where platform is now guaranteed on Apple platforms #122789
    area-System.Security, os-ios
  • Consolidate runtime helpers (X86Base, Interlocked, Buffer) across CoreCLR and NativeAOT #122791
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Refactor NativeAOT helpers to align with CoreCLR patterns #121158
    needs-area-label
  • Add packed SearchValues<string> specialization for two strings #122749
    NO-MERGE, area-System.Runtime
  • Fix FromBase64Transform buffer sizing and output buffer handling #122805
    area-System.Security
